main.name.description: Name of this knxd instance (used in logging and discovery)

main.enable.description: Enable the main knxd daemon (if false, knxd starts but does not process EIB frames)

main.device.description: Device path to the physical KNX interface (e.g., serial port or /dev/knxd)

main.connection_type.description: Type of physical connection: 'tpuarts' (serial), 'ip' (tunnel/routing over IP), etc.

server.enable.description: Enable the built-in KNX server for EIBnet/IP tunneling/routing

server.bind.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all, '127.0.0.1' for local-only)

server.multicast_enable.description: Enable multicast KNXnet/IP routing (requires compatible network infrastructure)

mcast.address.description: Multicast group address for KNXnet/IP routing

mcast.port.description: UDP port used for multicast KNX traffic

mcast.interface.description: Network interface name for multicast (e.g., 'eth0'); empty = let system decide

log.level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none) to 6 (debug); 4=notice is a good default for production

log.syslog.description: Send log output to syslog instead of standard error

log.logfile.description: Path to a file for log output; empty disables file logging

security.password_enable.description: Require passwords for client connections to the server

security.password_file.description: Path to file containing base64-encoded passwords (see knxd docs for format)

filter.suppressed_addresses.description: List of group addresses that knxd should not forward (useful for hiding internal addresses)

items.description: Group address in standard KNX format (e.g., '1/2/3', '5/2/0')

filter.ignored_physical_addresses.description: List of physical addresses to ignore (e.g., to avoid loopback traffic)

usb.vendor_id.description: USB vendor ID for KNX USB devices (hex string); typical for Philips/KNX devices

usb.product_id.description: USB product ID for KNX USB devices (hex string)
